measurement_settings.storage_backend_observation: This run captured /metrics after pausing TorrentNG and reported runtime_initialized=0 for the separate StorageRuntime. This metric did not observe the live peer-transfer MountScheduler, so the backend remains unknown; moving the scrape before pause alone cannot recover it.

notes.docker_stats: Docker-reported container working set, sampled at the configured interval.
notes.cgroup_memory_current: Container cgroup total, including anon and file cache.
notes.cgroup_cpu_usage: Cgroup v2 cpu.stat usage_usec; phase deltas are normalized by transferred payload bytes.
notes.cgroup_io: Cgroup v2 io.stat counters summed across devices. These are block-layer bytes and operations charged to the container; page-cache hits are not block I/O.
notes.network_bytes: RX/TX counters from non-loopback interfaces in the container network namespace; they include all namespace traffic, not just BitTorrent DHT packets.
notes.container_process_tree_rss: Host /proc RSS summed across each measured container's process tree. Shared pages can be counted in multiple processes.
notes.container_process_tree_pss: Host /proc PSS summed across each measured container's process tree. PSS divides shared pages proportionally and is distinct from cgroup memory.
notes.process_tree_memory_sampling: Process-tree RSS/PSS are sampled for every measured client at the configured interval, independent of the regular resource-sample interval. Unavailable readings are null.
notes.torrentng_process_rss: Host /proc status for torrentngd when available; detailed smaps and thread-name reads are enabled only in diagnostic runs.
notes.process_memory_snapshots: Diagnostic-only TorrentNG /proc status, thread names, smaps totals, and the 20 largest resident mappings captured with cgroup samples.
notes.process_identity_snapshots: Diagnostic-only process IDs, names, RSS, and anonymous RSS captured when TorrentNG cgroup anonymous memory exceeds its process anonymous RSS by more than 1 MiB. Command-line arguments are not recorded.
notes.engine_metrics: Diagnostic-only TorrentNG resource-governor leases, estimated peer-buffer capacities, storage-pool gauges, and optional allocator metrics sampled during transfer and at phase boundaries.
notes.storage_backend_observation: When TorrentNG is included, one authenticated /metrics scrape after its transfer windows and before its container stops records the selected backend and fixed-buffer capabilities without adding scrapes to measured intervals.
notes.jemalloc_metrics: Jemalloc allocator gauges are present only when the jemalloc-allocator feature is selected. They describe Jemalloc's allocator state, not total process allocations or RSS.
notes.source_fingerprint: SHA-256 derived from commit/tree, a normalized full-index Git diff, and all non-ignored untracked file paths and contents at benchmark start.
notes.process_memory: Linux /proc status RSS and anonymous RSS are process-level readings; detailed smaps samples are diagnostic-only and allocator gauges do not replace process RSS.
notes.unavailable_cgroup_counters: An empty CSV cell and null profile value mean the host/container runtime did not expose that counter.
